value.rationale: The theorem exposes structural group-action information entirely lost by the common nonequivariant graph wedge. It determines for every prime power q and 4<=n<=q+1 exactly which additive characters occur with the lower multiplicity, reconstructing the projective form-direction set. This supports a natural symmetry-sensitive invariant for orthogonal-array/generalized-inflation topology rather than a narrow arbitrary finite enumeration.
